data.body: PS4 CI (Verified gate, run 32055903153) failed the Module-size gate: registry.py hit 821 LOC (origin was 778, cap 800) — the module-size gate is CI-only, not in 'make lint', so it wasn't caught locally. Fixed by extracting the guide-rendering cluster (_guide_path/_guide_section_body/regenerate_criteria_guide/_guide_sections/validate_criteria_guide/explain_criterion) into a new sibling module src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_guide.py (130 LOC) along the existing call-graph seam, mirroring the det_gate_rules re-export precedent. registry.py now 733 LOC. ExplainError/explain_guide/AUTHOR_GUIDES stay in registry (the registry.resources monkeypatch surface); criteria_guide imports registry lazily inside functions so the top-level re-export is never circular and load_criteria monkeypatch is honored. lint+typecheck green; 323 focused tests pass incl. module-size contract, explain callers, guide parity. Amending PS5.
